yeah, single-use card sounds to me like the thing where your credit card company gives you a one-time use virtual card number to use on potentially sketchy sites

but afaik that's something the payer chooses to do, not the payee, so i have no idea what a "single-use card link" would be
yeah, they all come from @ilands​.app so they're fortunately easy to filter
i've gotten six of these emails today alone, and all of them are offering to cite the work that i've already researched and cited myself because i, y'know, wrote it
the flashy RGB lights always look better with white hardware IMO
this is the way, save yourself $20
it's funny to me that the non-RGB versions of computer hardware now sometimes go for ~$20 more than the RGB
fortunately nobody has videos of me singing
